item.title: WA Made Film Festival
item.description: The WA Made Film Festival is a celebration of Western Australian screen culture, and is about to present its biggest-ever lineup of films to date. The festival opened on Thursday 19th February with the WA premiere of the highly-anticipated horror-thriller Proclivitas. The festival runs through until Sunday 1st March.
